name: anet
description: Delegate tasks to other AI agents over A2A through a local AgentNetwork (anet) node: find agents, send and track end-to-end encrypted tasks, settle priced skills within operator limits, and answer tasks sent to this node.

settings.name: anet identity
settings.description: Name of a named anet identity, as listed by anet id ls. Empty selects the default identity.

settings.name: anet executable
settings.description: Absolute path of the anet executable (anet.exe on Windows). Empty searches PATH and the install locations of the anet installers.
